# FORM Build-System Maintenance

Read this document before modifying maintained build-system inputs or related
generation and distribution logic, or reviewing changes to any of them. It is
not required merely to configure, build, or test FORM; the shared commands and
build-directory guidance are in `AGENTS.md`.

## Maintained Inputs and Generated Files

- Edit Autotools sources such as `configure.ac`, `Makefile.am`, and files under
  `m4/`, not generated files such as `configure`, `Makefile.in`, `config.h`, or
  `aclocal.m4`.
- Change feature and platform detection in `configure.ac`. When adding,
  removing, or renaming a build input, update the owning `Makefile.am`.
- Add source, test, and other files intended for release archives to the
  appropriate source or distribution list. Do not add ignored generated
  Autotools outputs.
- Repository-maintenance guidance intended only for use in Git checkouts is
  intentionally excluded from release archives.
- `sources/version.h` and documentation version fragments are generated by
  `scripts/git-version-gen.sh`. Do not hard-code a development version into
  generated output.

## Verification

- After changing `configure.ac`, any `Makefile.am`, or files under `m4/`, run
  `autoreconf -i`, configure a clean or otherwise suitable out-of-source build,
  and build the affected targets.
- Run `make -C build-agent distcheck` for changes that affect distribution
  contents, installation, release versioning, or generated documentation. As
  with the other commands in `AGENTS.md`, adapt the build directory when local
  tooling or the task uses another location.
